verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm being compared against other firms, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a category error for this kind of product. Its Visalaw AI product does not change that, because nothing in the evidence shows it exposes a public API. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes on visalaw.com both returned 404s, which is consistent with the firm not shipping an API.
